title: Add all-method shared regression matrix
description: Create a single evidence matrix proving all nine methods satisfy the shared configuration, lifecycle, error, cleanup, and resource contract.
acceptanceCriteria: The matrix enumerates all nine methods and the same behavioral checks for each
A method cannot be marked complete without configuration, lifecycle, error, cleanup, and reconnect/resource evidence
Fixtures distinguish local command/config generation from real remote/binary evidence
The matrix output is machine-readable and linked from release evidence

steps.description: Write a test that expects every method to have a result record and fails when a method is missing or only has a builder test.
Create a stable record with method, config, lifecycle, failure, cleanup, reconnect/resource, real-binary, and evidence references.
Map current tests to the matrix without claiming unverified real-binary/VPS behavior.
Run the matrix validator and retain a sanitized result in `.agent/evidence/tunnel-matrix.md`.

technicalNotes: A method builder test alone is insufficient for release acceptance; the matrix must state what was not exercised.
